    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    CausalClock
    The clock a plain Kafka client stamps records with: a running view of the client's causal past, built from the records it observed and its own acknowledged sends.
    CausalHeaders
    The wire vocabulary: "vc" carries the record's dependency clock, and "vc-sender" / "vc-seq" carry the sender tag that lets receivers resolve sequence claims against this record.
    CausalStreams
    The running application: a curated view of the Kafka Streams runtime, assembled by Parsley.streams(Properties) and started here.
    Codec<T>
    A pure byte codec: two total functions between a value and its bytes.
    ContractProbes
    Executable checks for the application contract (docs/guide/expectations.md): every clause that is mechanically checkable runs in the application's own test suite, before deploy, instead of being remembered.
    ContractProbes.Finding
    One probe result: which probe, what it observed, and the contract clause it checks.
    ContractProbes.Report
    The outcome of a probe run: failures to act on, notes to read.
    ContractProbes.Samples
    Sample records for ContractProbes.probe(Parsley, ContractProbes.Samples, Path): at least one per source topic, so every handler path is exercised.
    CorruptClockException
    A present but undecodable clock header.
    Emission
    One output of user logic: a key and value bound for a topic, as a value.
    Fold<S,K,V>
    Stateful user logic: a pure step function over per-key state.
    Handler<K,V>
    Stateless user logic: a pure function from a delivered message to the emissions it causes.
    Message<K,V>
    A causally delivered message: the decoded key and value plus the message's own coordinate — its source topic, partition, offset, and timestamp.
    Parsley
    The front door: a composition of Stages, and the two ways to run it — a broker-less topology for TopologyTestDriver, or a CausalStreams runtime against a real cluster.
    Stage
    One causal processing stage: typed source topics, each handled by pure user logic (a Handler or, with per-key state, a Fold), and typed sink topics — with the causal boundary in between.
    Stage.Builder
    Builds a stateless stage; Stage.Builder.state(Codec, Supplier) upgrades it to a stateful one.
    Stage.Stateful<S>
    Builds a stateful stage: sources may fold over the declared per-key state.
    Step<S>
    The result of one Fold application: the state to persist for the key (null deletes it) and the emissions the message caused.
    Tick
    One delivered tick: a record the stage runtime emits to the stage's own tick channel at the declared interval and consumes back through the causal gate like any other record.
    TickFold<S>
    Stateful tick logic: a pure step function over the stage's tick state.
    TickHandler
    Stateless tick logic: a pure function from a delivered Tick to the emissions it causes.
    Topic<K,V>
    A typed topic: name and codecs declared once, then shared.
